The character modelling and world design are really well done. The UI is clean and easy to navigate. There are some bugs with crafting tables if they are placed too close together but other than that it is a fantastic game.

Enjoying the game so far. Hopefully they will be adding more content to the game at a later date. But I do think that it is well worth the price, especially considering what a full $60-70 game gets you anymore. It has its share of bugs but is a lot less buggy than most new releases in the survival genre. I do recommend setting up a dedicated server if you plan on doing multiplayer. The official servers... not that great.
